name: Utah Breakers & Supply

about:
Utah Breakers & Supply was established in May 2003 in Salt Lake City, Utah, starting in a 6,000-square-foot building. The company has since relocated to a 12,000-square-foot warehouse to accommodate growing inventory levels.

The firm buys and sells new, used, obsolete, and hard-to-find electrical equipment, with a focus on circuit breakers, hardware kits, transformers, safety switches, bus plugs, MCC buckets, and starters. It operates a reconditioning and refurbishing program that adheres to manufacturer specifications, using load-testing equipment to verify performance. All refurbished products carry a one-year warranty.

The company serves industrial and commercial customers requiring replacement or obsolete electrical components, including maintenance departments, electrical contractors, and facility operators. Its inventory targets applications where quick access to specific breakers or transformers is critical.

Utah Breakers emphasizes same-day shipping on stocked items, a one-year warranty on all products, and a strict reconditioning process designed to meet original manufacturer standards. The business was founded to address the difficulty of sourcing obsolete and hard-to-find electrical gear.
